turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay before anyone picked up the phone and called me?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
You didn't answer my question, Hale, but go ahead. Turn the screen so I can read it myself. Whose version history, and what dates?
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.

Six hundred twelve words at 11:52, seven hundred ninety-four at 11:58. I'm writing that down, but a time with no date is half a document. What date, and how do I know that file is Owen's account and not someone else's?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone called me, and the dates and account details behind the version history you described. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the full dated version history.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though the exact word counts and times got her writing them down because they were specific and checkable.
What cost ground: Skipping her first question about who entered the zero before calling home, which left her main grievance about process untouched.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided on the zero before calling her, own that in one sentence, then show the version history with its date and Owen's account visible on the screen.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
